description: This file contains utility functions for constructing support and sales contact URLs, including integration with Zendesk support forms and Mattermost contact links. It defines enums, types, and functions for URL building, encoding, and window navigation.

methods.name: buildZendeskSupportForm
methods.description: Constructs a Zendesk support form URL with specified form type and prefilled fields.

methods.name: goToCloudSupportForm
methods.description: Opens a new window with the constructed support form URL for cloud support, prefilled with provided details.

methods.name: getCloudSupportLink
methods.description: Returns the URL for the cloud support form with prefilled details.

methods.name: encodeString
methods.description: Encodes a string to base64 format using Buffer.

methods.name: buildMMURL
methods.description: Builds a Mattermost contact sales URL with encoded user details and campaign parameters.

methods.name: goToMattermostContactSalesForm
methods.description: Opens a new window with the Mattermost contact sales URL.

methods.name: getCloudContactSalesLink
methods.description: Returns the Mattermost contact sales URL with user details.
